subject: Security & subprocessor mapping — action items and next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Miller <jmiller@healthsync.io>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.k@healthsync.io>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo security follow-up & initial asks

Thanks for the demo this morning — appreciate the walkthrough of Redwood Inference and the performance/price tradeoffs. A couple of security/compliance items we need to kick off from our side so we can move toward legal/procurement: 

1) SOC 2 report: do you have a current SOC 2 report (Type II preferred) or an auditor/attestation timeline?
2) Subprocessor list and cloud footprint: we need a list of cloud providers and third-party vendors that could access PHI/PII in scoped workloads.
3) Data flow diagram: a high-level diagram showing where customer data is stored, transient in memory, and transmitted to downstream systems.
4) HIPAA / BAA: HealthSync handles PHI for some customers — please confirm whether Redwood will sign a BAA and any prerequisites.
5) Security questionnaire: attaching our standard questionnaire (PDF). Can you confirm who on your side will own it and an estimated turnaround?

We're trying to align procurement timing with our Q3 security review — ideally get these materials within ~2 weeks. Happy to set a short follow-up with your security rep if helpful.

Thanks,
Jordan Miller
Director, Integrations — HealthSync
jmiller@healthsync.io
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: healthsync_security_questionnaire.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jmiller@healthsync.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo security follow-up & initial asks

Jordan — thanks for the note and great to meet. Copying Ben (sales) and Marissa (security/compliance) to help run the pack. Below are what I can share immediately and proposed next steps.

Quick answers and deliverables we can provide this week:
- Subprocessors: attached a first-pass CSV (redwood_subprocessors_v1.csv). It lists cloud infra providers, telemetry vendors, and a few managed services. Fields: vendor, role, region, data access (yes/no), contact.
- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type I assessment in Nov 2026 and we are currently in the middle of our Type II audit. Expected report delivery: target 2027-09-30 (auditor: Greybridge). We can provide an interim controls letter and scope statement immediately.
- Data flow: we'll produce a scoped data flow diagram for the HealthSync integration (shows tokenization/KV cache, short-lived inference artifacts, and customer-configured S3 configs). Draft by 2027-07-28.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads on our Private deployment; for hosted customers we require a short security review and an executed BAA. Ben and Marissa will surface any configuration prerequisites (encryption at rest, retention settings).
- Security questionnaire: we'll start filling HealthSync's attached PDF. Marissa will own the questionnaire and expects a first pass by 2027-07-26.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Marissa to send the interim controls letter + subprocessor CSV (done here).
- Ben to share a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and legal contacts.
- Schedule a 30-min technical sync between HealthSync infra and Redwood security (propose 2027-07-29/30).

If that works, Ben / Marissa — can you confirm owners and timelines? Jordan — also, is your security team available for a 30-min call next week? 

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_subprocessors_v1.csv

- 2027-07-26: Redwood returns first-pass questionnaire answers (Marissa).

- 2027-08-10: Data flow confirmation (diagram sign-off).

Thanks Ben / Soojin — that timeline looks good to us and aligns with our internal Q3 intake. Quick notes: 

- Our security contact is security@healthsync.io (they'll lead questionnaire review).
- We'll aim to return the completed questionnaire by EOD 2027-08-05. If we have clarifying Qs, we'll flag them directly in the PDF.
- We require a BAA for any PHI-handling in production. We'll have our legal rep review your BAA template; target to have comments back by 2027-08-17.
- The 30-min technical sync on 2027-07-29/30 didn't work for our infra; can we move to 2027-08-06 at 10:00 AM PT? That gives us time to review your subprocessor CSV and draft data flow.

> Soojin Lee wrote:
> > Subprocessors: attached a first-pass CSV (redwood_subprocessors_v1.csv).

We'll plan for the 2027-08-06 technical sync at 10:00 AM PT (please confirm) and will upload the completed questionnaire to the HubSpot record. Thanks all for the quick turnaround.
